game_start.intro: Agyapadeɛ no hyɛ ase. Trump suit: {trump_suit} (trump kaa: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Wɔyɛ ɔgya {player_id} wɔ German Whist.
{phase_info}
Wɔwɔ {hand_size} kaa.
Di kaa a ɛwɔ '[play N]', a ɛyɛ ne dibea wɔ wo nsam (sɛ nhwɛso '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: ASƐM A WOBETUMI: Ɔko biara mu nkonimdifo no nya kaade a ɛda anim, na nea wadi nkonim nso twe krataa foforo fi ɔfasuo no so. Akwankyerɛ ahorow a w'adi wɔ saa bere yi mu no nka ho mfa nni nkonim.
player_prompt.phase_playing: ƆKWƐN A WƆDE DI: wɔagyae agude no nyinaa. Efi saa bere yi rekɔ, anammɔn biara a wobɛyɛ no bɛboa ma woadi nkonim.

next_card.playing_phase: Wɔmfa krataa biara mma - agodie no afi ase.
next_card.deck_empty: Agodi no yɛ hwee - wɔmmɔ kaade biara.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ntotoe a enni mu. Fa '[play N]' di dwuma de adi nkrataa a ɛto so N wɔ wo nsam no ho dwuma.
invalid_move.bad_position: Saa krataa no gyinabea nni hɔ. Wo kura {hand_size} nkrataa a, na wo de yɛ adwuma wɔ ɔfese foforo so.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Ɛsɛ sɛ wusuasua no na wode {lead_suit} kaade di dwuma.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Wontumi mfa saa kaade no nni dwuma.

game_action.played: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} bɔɔ ɔbaa no a ɔde {card}.

trick.won_learning: Player {winner_id} wins the trick with {card} and takes the face-up card.

phase.learning_complete: Wɔama pon no so ayɛ ma. Adesua a wɔresua no aba awiei - agoru biara a aka ho hia de kɔ nkonimdi mu.

draw.winner_received: Woadi nkonim wɔ agoru no mu na woanya {card}.
draw.loser_received: Woadi nkogu na woayi {card} afi ɔfasu no mu.
draw.winner_preview: Krataa a edi hɔ no yɛ {card}.
